evidence.reason: After edit calls reminders.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benchmark") and returns reminders.historySizderUnit, which is not a defined symbol; the original returned a positive value derived from evaluate(minutes, ...).
New early return `if (minutes === 0) return 0;` means evaluate(0, ...) yields 0 and skips history.splice, so historySize() stays 0.
Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, but merged code evaluates with 0 and returns an invalid property, so the assertion fails.
Test expects history to be populated; with minutes=0 the early return prevents history.splice, so historySize() remains 0.

result.userExplanation: 这两处修改合并后，scheduledDelay 会以 0 分钟调用 evaluate，而 reminderDelay 对 0 直接返回 0，导致返回值无效且历史记录不再更新，破坏了原有测试所依赖的行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts 中的 scheduledDelay：恢复为 reminders.initialize() 并调用 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work")，返回 reminders.evaluate(...) / reminders.reminderUnit，不要使用不存在的 historySizderUnit；同时确认 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的 minutes===0 提前返回不会影响 evaluate 对正数分钟的正常路径。
